# Accuracy harness: floor tier

- Environment: `abcd1234`
- Started: 2026-10-09T12:30:00Z
- Finished: 2026-10-09T13:30:00Z
- Tolerances: testing.md section 5: each direction's headline against mean(iperf3 before, after), and its loaded latency against the concurrent ICMP ping, judged per run as pass, fail or inconclusive
- Loaded latency: each direction measured with websocket or http-h1-reserved: its increase over idle within ±20 % or 10 ms, whichever is larger, of the ICMP ping's increase from idle latency's window to the direction's after I_s; the grade on the letter of the larger ping increase its basis names, or the adjacent letter within that tolerance of a threshold; http-h2 and http-h3 recorded, not judged
- No-egress layer: no packet egress (netguard counters, from BitGauge's start to the end of the run)

## Manual runs this tier requires

- one real Android Chrome run over an actual VPN
- one real iOS Safari run over an actual VPN

## Environmental limits

- tc shaping jitter (tbf burst sizes, netem timer granularity).
- Docker bridge overhead at high rates.
- Playwright WebKit ≠ Safari: Worker XHR and nextHopProtocol behavior must be re-checked on real Safari.
- Mobile power management: device runs happen with the screen on.

What the harness cannot prove: real Wi-Fi behavior, real VPN MTU effects, carrier-grade NAT, and anything about networks the project does not target.
